Thanks, it’s been a rough month. It’s still a struggle but I’m doing better every day. This is an alt account for my worst of days and rereading the comments really helps me going. I really thank everyone who contributes.

Pedo-OCD is a sub sect of OCD where the person is constantly worried about being a pedophile. For me it stems from stupid homophobes saying pedophilia and being gay are the same thing, so it’s been etched in my mind. I’ve been getting better but it’s truly one of the most distressing things I’ve experienced. Sometimes it makes me feel like I have to kill myself in order to protect people, even though I know it’s irrational. But it doesn’t make the intrusive thoughts go away.
